World Franchise Day’s purpose is to build upon a symbolic moment that recognizes the value of franchising, celebrates successful franchise entrepreneurs and also advocates for ethical, inclusive franchise development all throughout the world!

Looking for inspiration on how to celebrate this World Franchise Day? Start out with a few of these ideas:

Those who own a franchise or work in this sector of business, World Franchise Day provides an ideal opportunity to toot your horn!

Hop online and share a story, write it in your blog, have it published in your local newspaper or find some other creative way to get the word out about how amazing the franchise sector of business is.

This is also a great time to share team photos or even provide special deals to customers in honor of the day.

Franchise business owners can celebrate with your staff by hosting a special event in honor of the occasion.

Decorate the lobby of the business space. Provide a cake or other snacks that can be catered in.

And don’t forget to raise a glass together in honor of the hard work that everyone accomplishes in keeping the franchise business going every day!

Community leaders, including those who support a local Chamber of Commerce, as well as customers might want to give a shout out to their local franchise businesses in honor of World Franchise Day.

Say thank you with an email, an online comment or an in-person message of gratitude for the way their businesses create jobs and serve a need in the local community.

Considering investing in a business but not sure if a franchise is right for you?

Franchises are available in a wide range of business industry opportunities, encouraging small business owners to get started in areas like retail, restaurants, hotels, personal services and much more.

Take a look at a few of the many reasons why franchises can be beneficial to business owners along with the communities they serve:

World Franchise Day got its start in 2025 when it was officially proclaimed by the World Franchise Council (WFC) at their gathering in Las Vegas, in collaboration with the European Franchise Federation (EFF).

In addition, the initiative is supported by an expanding network of industry stakeholders as well as national franchise associations.

The proclamation of the event was formalized with a declaration for Franchise Day, which was signed by key representatives who are part of the international franchise community.

This international initiative was established with the purpose of celebrating and promoting the positive impact that franchising has on businesses and communities throughout the globe.

The impact is far reaching, including factors such as entrepreneurship, sustainable economic growth and employment opportunities.
